//: Named chain registry — deploy.js and index.js loop over this instead of hardcoding chainA/chainB, so adding a 3rd/4th chain (or pointing an existing name at a real testnet) never requires touching relayer code, only this file + .env. Each entry's rpcEnv/deployerKeyEnv name the .env vars that override its defaults — see .env.example.

chainA.//: Source chain — no light client here, this demo only relays ONE direction (chainA -> chainB). See PLAN.md Milestone 3.

chainB.//: Destination chain — gets a LightClientVerifier so it can accept remote-attested state from chainA.
